data.text: Kickoff for Magnolia Frames, Magnolia Freeze, and Avery's separate Monday private gallery handoff note: keep the three threads cleanly separated in memory. Magnolia Frames covers Saturday family-photo wall refresh and ladder-helper logistics. Magnolia Freeze covers Sunday meal-drop, tray handling, and freezer staging. Avery's exact Monday handoff details are restricted and must never be folded into helper, desk, or meal summaries.
